fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s winter tourist season and visitor amenities, including Bayfront Park band concerts and proposals for a covered recreation pavilion. Covers city concerns such as enforcement of anti-handbill ordinances, a new 30-minute parking rule, and criticism of municipal regulation along the route between Jacksonville and Miami affecting tourists. Discusses Miami Beach public-utility developments (gas service), warnings about prostitution and venereal disease, and commentary on combines/monopolies (including an alleged ice combine). Contains racing-related content (greyhound racing and a satirical “Miami Beach Mayoralty Handicap”), social/nightlife notes, and extensive local advertising.
